# Complete original CUDA fixtures

The full original `dev/cuda/crossentropy_forward.cu` and
`llmc/fused_classifier.cuh` come from the immutable CUDA corpus input based on
`https://github.com/karpathy/llm.c`. The retained MIT license is copied verbatim.
The inputs are source-text fixtures and are never compiled or executed as kernels.

The complete files retain 5192 and 6949 bytes respectively, with SHA-256 values
`6eef55e580b158114dc2e80183c4efbe133c3efae627ba12a4485a6e78a1b717`
and `f79468bf7033e5823ca96a0136f1d0ae2cf0607989c405c5f27db0fc3dffec98`.
Their byte offsets are part of the oracle; line endings must remain unchanged.
